'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Chris Thompson LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Thompson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Unnumbered [[Padme Naberrie (V)]] below line 36 included with all five [[Imperial Atrocity (V)]]. Lines 59–60 also list [[Your Insight Serves You Well]] / [[I Hope She's All Right]] in the main 60. Extra duplicate Tragedy shield notes on sheet not double-counted.

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Thompson]]

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
